injuries.detail: Allen (concussion) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Grizzlies.
Miller is probable for Monday's game against the Grizzlies due to a right knee contusion.
Williams (hamstring) won't play Monday's game against the Grizzlies.
Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
Grant was diagnosed with a grade 1 left calf strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.
Boozer (ankle) won't play Monday's game against the Hornets.
